newsitem.title: USA: Brookdale Living cuts number of IPO shares.
newsitem.headline: Brookdale Living cuts number of IPO shares.

text.p: Brookdale Living Communities Inc has cut the number of shares it plans to offer in its coming initial public offering.
According to a regulatory filing, the Chicago company will offer 5,625,000 shares, down from its original estimate of 6.25 million.
The price range remains $15 to $17 a share.
The shares are to trade on the Nasdaq under the symbol "BLCI." Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette is the lead underwriter of the offering, which is on "to be announced" status.
The company provides senior and assisted living services to the elderly in metropolitan markets.
